newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama consumer price index unchanged in April.
newsitem.headline: Panama consumer price index unchanged in April.

text.p: Panama's consumer price index was unchanged in April after dipping 0.4 percent in March, the Comptroller General's office said.

Inflation over the last 12 months slowed to 1.2 percent, compared with 1.3 percent in the year to April 1996, it said in a release. Cumulative inflation from January to April 1997 stood at 0.6 percent.
Economists attribute Panama's low inflation primarily to its use of the U.S. dollar as national currency and long-standing wage and price controls.
